heading: WANTED
text: An identity element, any age, for a lonely semigroup of order four. Must act the same on both sides. Apply to the Monoid Bureau.

heading: LOST
text: One inverse, answers to $a^{-1}$. Last seen in a group. Reward offered; it will reply uniquely and ask no questions.

heading: FOR SALE
text: Full transformation monoid on seven points, one careful owner. $7^7 = 823543$ elements, all in working order.

heading: SITUATIONS VACANT
text: Zero required for busy Rees quotient. Must absorb everything and ask for nothing. Excellent prospects.

heading: TO LET
text: Spacious two-sided ideal in a quiet neighbourhood. Whatever enters stays. Suit a retired idempotent.

heading: PERSONAL
text: Commutative band seeks semilattice for long walks along the Hasse diagram. Meet only; no joining.

heading: LOST
text: A generator. Distinguishing mark: every element is a power of it. Please return to the cyclic semigroup in Index Road.

heading: WANTED
text: A finite basis for a stubborn variety. Previous applicants proved unsuitable. Infinite lists will not be considered.

heading: NOTICE
text: The word problem has been undecidable since 1947. The Management regrets any inconvenience.

heading: FOR SALE
text: Opposite pair: one left zero, one right zero. Neither is commutative, both are bands. Collect in person.

heading: LESSONS
text: Instruction given in the relations $\mathcal{R}$, $\mathcal{L}$, $\mathcal{H}$, $\mathcal{D}$ and $\mathcal{J}$. Egg-box supplied. Beginners welcome.

heading: WANTED
text: Associativity. Bracketing at present unreliable. Reward for the safe return of $(xy)z = x(yz)$.

heading: PERSONAL
text: Idempotent, steady, seeks the same. Meeting twice changes nothing, which is exactly how we like it.

heading: FOR SALE
text: Symmetric inverse monoid on two points, slightly used. Seven partial bijections, all injective, all reversible.

heading: SITUATIONS VACANT
text: Brandt semigroup requires matrix units. Must compose when they fit and vanish when they do not.

heading: NOTICE
text: The Eilenberg Correspondence is held daily between the pseudovarieties and the regular languages. All are welcome.

heading: LOST
text: A Frobenius number. Last seen as the largest integer missing from a numerical semigroup. Finder please notify the gap-keeper.

heading: LESSONS
text: Krohn-Rhodes decomposition taught patiently. Wreath products demonstrated. Flip-flops provided; bring your own finite simple groups.

heading: TO LET
text: Cyclic semigroup of index four and period two. Five elements, a short tail and a tidy loop. Viewing by appointment.

heading: FOR SALE
text: Free semigroup on two letters, never used. Words supplied in unlimited length. Concatenation included at no extra charge.

heading: WANTED
text: Mirror for an opposite semigroup. Must reverse every product faithfully and leave the elements none the wiser.

heading: PERSONAL
text: Will the semigroup who borrowed my identity please return it? It is wanted urgently. $1x = x$.

heading: NOTICE
text: Coffee is served at the Commutator Cafe, where it never matters whether the milk or the espresso goes first.

heading: LOST
text: A finite cancellative semigroup, believed to have become a group. If found, please do not be alarmed.
